issue.title: Let the user choose Public/Private when creating the GitHub repo (gh needs a visibility flag)

successCriteria.description: Creating a GitHub repo (from the post-Initialize prompt OR the Settings checklist) first lets the user choose Public or Private, and the emitted gh repo create command includes the matching --public/--private flag.
Cancelling the chooser is a clean no-op; the chooser is shared by both call sites (no duplicated UI); the command is never emitted without a visibility flag.

phases.title: Shared Public/Private visibility chooser (imperative dialog + store + root mount)
phases.content: Add a reusable visibility chooser so both create-repo call sites can ask Public vs Private. MIRROR the existing imperative-dialog pattern — read apps/desktop/src/stores/releaseDialogStore.ts and its ReleaseDialog component (find where it is mounted, likely App.tsx) to match conventions. Create: (1) a small store (e.g. apps/desktop/src/stores/createRepoDialogStore.ts) holding { open: boolean, projectName: string|null, resolve: ((v:'public'|'private'|null)=>void)|null } with an imperative async API `requestRepoVisibility(projectName: string): Promise<'public'|'private'|null>` that opens the dialog and returns a promise resolved by the user's choice (public/private) or null (cancel/close); export it from the stores index if that is the convention. (2) a CreateRepoDialog component (apps/desktop/src/components/... matching where ReleaseDialog lives) + .css: a small modal titled e.g. 'Create GitHub repo for <projectName>' with two clear choices Public and Private (buttons or a radio + Create), and Cancel/close; choosing resolves the promise with 'public'/'private', Cancel/Escape/backdrop resolves null. (3) Mount <CreateRepoDialog/> once at the app root next to where <ReleaseDialog/> (or equivalent dialogs) is mounted. Keep styling consistent with existing dialogs. No fresh-ref violations; keep the store minimal.
verification: pnpm -C apps/desktop build (tsc -b strict) is clean
pnpm -C apps/desktop test passes (272 baseline, no regression)
pnpm -C apps/desktop lint adds zero new errors
createRepoDialogStore exposes requestRepoVisibility(projectName) returning Promise<'public'|'private'|null>; CreateRepoDialog is mounted once at app root
phases.summary: createRepoDialogStore (requestRepoVisibility(name): Promise<'public'|'private'|null>) + CreateRepoDialog.tsx/.css (Public/Private buttons, Cancel/Esc/backdrop→null) mounted at app root by ReleaseDialog pattern; exported via stores index. build clean, vitest 272, lint 0 new

phases.title: Wire the chooser into both create-repo call sites + append the flag
phases.content: Use the Phase-1 chooser at BOTH places that emit `gh repo create`, replacing the bare command with one that carries the chosen visibility flag. (1) apps/desktop/src/components/sidebar/ProjectsSection.tsx — in the #298 readiness-gated create-repo effect, replace the `window.confirm("Create a GitHub repo...")` with `const vis = await requestRepoVisibility(pending.name)`; if vis is 'public'|'private' -> writeToProjectTerminal(pending.projectId, `gh repo create --source=. --remote=origin --${vis}\n`) + switch to terminal view; if null -> clean no-op. Preserve the fire-once clearing + re-entry guard + the no-remote (git_remote_get) gate. (2) apps/desktop/src/components/settings/GreenfieldChecklist.tsx — in the createRemote Fix handler (#287), replace the direct write with `const vis = await requestRepoVisibility(<project name or 'this project'>)`; on a choice write `gh repo create --source=. --remote=origin --${vis}\n` to the terminal (keep the existing auth-first guard + switch-to-terminal-view + no-terminal toast); on null no-op. The command must NEVER be emitted without a --public/--private flag. Keep both flows otherwise unchanged (selection, terminal targeting, etc.).

pnpm -C apps/desktop test passes (272 baseline, no regression)
pnpm -C apps/desktop lint adds zero new errors (fresh-ref + exhaustive-deps on the #298 effect with the new async call)
grep confirms neither call site emits 'gh repo create' without a --public/--private flag

VISUAL (tauri:dev): both the post-Initialize prompt and the Settings checklist Fix first show the Public/Private chooser; choosing writes 'gh repo create --source=. --remote=origin --public' (or --private); cancel is a no-op
phases.summary: Wired requestRepoVisibility into both call sites: ProjectsSection #298 effect (window.confirm → chooser, append --public/--private, fire-once+guards preserved) + GreenfieldChecklist #287 Fix (auth-first kept, repo-create branch asks visibility).
